description: List the safety and upkeep notices: title, topic, who each one is for, a summary and its id. Pass the tool the person builds with to get only what applies to it. Use this before work on login, payments, personal data or deleting data, and when asked what to check before going live. Call get_notice with an id for the checklist, the steps and the messages to paste.

tool.description: Only what applies to this tool. Leave out for everything.
